facts.fact: The national Open Data steering committee (COPIL), meeting at the Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD), debated a 2026 action plan of the government's Open Data programme that includes enriching and maintaining the national open data portal www.data.gov.ma; the document names no open data policy, strategy or law behind the portal and gives no dataset or publisher count.

systems.country_label: Portail de l'Open Data au Maroc
systems.owner: Government of Morocco; Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD) hosts the national Open Data steering committee
systems.tiers: national; producers are public bodies and institutions

note: No standing fact: the document records an action plan and a steering committee, not a policy being drafted or adopted; a hackathon, training workshops, API interfacing and Responsables Open Data designations are planned or class other.
